subject: Question 6 Fire Headquarters Debt Exclusion
overview: Firefighters union secretary Danielle Marcellino addressed the public to urge a "no" vote on Question 6, a $30 million debt exclusion for a new fire headquarters. Marcellino stated that the proposed building plan fails to meet department needs and criticized the city for excluding firefighters from the design process while asking taxpayers to fund the entire cost.

items.title: Firefighters Union Opposition to Question 6
items.summary: Union Secretary Danielle Marcellino urged residents to vote against the $30 million debt exclusion for a new fire headquarters, citing inadequate accommodations, the lack of a proper training tower, exclusion of firefighters from planning, and the total cost being placed on taxpayers.
